ContextMenu_LGEP_Plumb_tooltip: Pipe this collector into the building, so it feeds every plumbed fixture in it. Needs a pipe wrench.
ContextMenu_LGEP_Disconnect_tooltip: Takes this collector off the building's plumbing. It keeps its water and goes on catching rain.
ContextMenu_LGEP_PlumbFed_tooltip: Pipe this to the building's supply, so it is kept full from the collectors. Tainted water comes out clean. Needs a pipe wrench.
ContextMenu_LGEP_SetReserve_tooltip: Nothing is drawn from this collector until every other one is empty. Its water still counts on your taps.
ContextMenu_LGEP_ClearReserve_tooltip: This collector drains along with the others again.
ContextMenu_LGEP_PlumbedLiquid_tooltip: Pick which liquid this fixture draws from the building's collectors. A mixture counts as its own liquid.
ContextMenu_LGEP_LiquidNone: Nothing in this building holds any.
ContextMenu_LGEP_KeptFor_tooltip: This collector is empty but still part of that liquid's plumbing. Pour something else in and it switches.
ContextMenu_LGEP_InSupply_tooltip: A collector joins the supply for everything in it, so this one is off the plain water taps. Empty it to put it back.
ContextMenu_LGEP_NoSupply_NoRoom: It has to be in a room, or in a building with a roof over most of it.
ContextMenu_LGEP_NoSupply_NoneHere: No rain collector anywhere in this building.
ContextMenu_LGEP_NoSupply_Empty: %1 plumbed collector(s) reach this and all are empty. It is set to draw %2.
ContextMenu_LGEP_NoSupply_NotPlumbed: %1 rain collector(s) nearby, none plumbed in. Use a pipe wrench on one.
ContextMenu_LGEP_NoSupply_Gravity: %1 plumbed collector(s) nearby, none above this. Water only runs down. Move one upstairs, or run a generator to it.
ContextMenu_LGEP_NoSupply_Liquid: The collectors that reach this hold %1. It is set to draw %2.
ContextMenu_LGEP_ShowPipedArea_tooltip: See where this plumbing reaches, and lay or lift pipes.
